rules.statement: A Fiscal's transfer, being a deed, is subject to the provisions of section 17 of Ordinance No. 14 of 1891.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not think that in view of the language of section 17 it can. fairly be argued that a Fiscal's transfer does not fall within the purview of Ordinance No. 14 of 1891"
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Every deed, judgment, order, or other instrument an aforesaid, unless so registered, shall be deemed void as against all parties claiming an adverse interest there to on valuable consideration by virtue of any subsequent deed, judgment, order, or other instrument which shall have been duly registered as aforesaid. Provided, however, that fraud or collusion in obtaining as last-mentioned deed. judgment, order, or other instrument, or in securing such prior registration, shall defeat the priority of the person claiming there under; and that nothing herein contained shall be deemed to give any greater effect or different construction to any deed judgment, order, or other instrument registered in pursuance hereof, save the priority hereby conferred on it.
